skill_name: Given the following facts, write a persuasive essay to convince someone that climate change is real.
workflow: Climate change is real, and the evidence for it is overwhelming. Global temperatures are rising at an alarming rate and carbon dioxide levels are higher than at any time in the past 800,000 years. Icecaps and glaciers are melting rapidly, impacting the environment and threatening the livelihoods of many people around the world.
